points.why: It says the unwelcome conclusion is being fought by attacking assumptions and that more detail won't end that, but it never says outright that a correct model nobody believes changes nothing.
It says more detail won't win the argument, but it suggests input sign-off from assumption owners and a contractor scenario rather than a live rebuild with leadership that agrees the boundary first.
Its attrition sensitivity and break-even analysis is a clear swing test, but it doesn't recommend naming the value-laden choices openly.
It doesn't track which leaders helped draw the model versus only saw results, or plan conversations on that basis.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly rejects detail-building as the answer and redirects to sensitivity analysis, reframing and stakeholder buy-in.
